messages:
sara_support: @here HarborWell just opened an audit/retention escalation. Customer reports their BAA-covered workspace shows 730d retention in Console but when they run an export the audit logs only return ~90 days. They need a forensics-ready export for 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-15 and are blocked. cc @olivia_security

mike_sre: looking. can you paste the export command they ran and the raw response?

sara_support: they used the UI export (Compliance > Audit logs > Export) and also tried API:
```http
GET /v1/audit/logs?start=2025-11-01T00:00:00Z&end=2025-11-15T23:59:59Z
Authorization: Bearer [redacted]
```
Response (API): 200 OK, items: []
UI: shows "Export created" but export file is ~700KB and events only from 2025-10-xx onward. Customer claims earlier events missing.

raj_oncall: any recent changes to retention backend or a config migration for HarborWell?

carl_engineer: Not that I'm aware of. We did a KMS rotation for a subset of customers on 2025-10-28 to move keys to new HSM-backed key ring. Are they on the affected key ring?

sara_support: HarborWell org id org-9876. They were listed in the rollout sheet as "phase 2" — I'll attach the sheet in the ticket.

olivia_security: tagging for KMS/HSM/BAA implications. Missing audit history is a showstopper for HIPAA. Need to verify whether logs were rekeyed vs reindexed. If keys were rotated without re-encrypting older blobs for the new key, exports could filter out objects not accessible with current key.

mike_sre: quick repro steps I asked HarborWell to run: 1) try export via API with ?debug=1 header, 2) call raw storage list for audit-bucket prefix using our internal signed URL we gave them. They ran step 1 and included debug: shows backend returned 206 partial/zero-objects for older prefix, code path: audit-exporter v2.4.1.

sara_support: customer also saw a 403 when trying to download an older encrypted export object directly:
```
GET https://storage.redwood-inference/prod-audit/harborwell/2025-09-15-logs.gz
Response: 403 Forbidden - kms:KeyNotAllowed
```

olivia_security: kms:KeyNotAllowed strongly indicates the object is encrypted with a key that current service principal no longer has decrypt permissions for. This ties to rotation if ACLs/policies weren't updated. We need: KMS audit (who changed IAM), list of cryptoKeyVersions used by that bucket prefix, and HSM attestation if HSM-backed.

raj_oncall: I can pull KMS IAM change history and CryptoKeyVersion metadata. @mike_sre can you check exporter logs around 2025-10-28-2025-10-31 to see if we rolled re-encryption jobs or skipped any orgs?

mike_sre: confirming. quick grep shows a rekey job ran but flagged errors for org-9876 at 2025-10-29 03:12 UTC: "rekey: object decrypt failed: kms:KeyNotFound" then retries, then mark skipped after 3 attempts. So older objects may remain encrypted under old key version that no longer exists or was disabled.

olivia_security: next steps (high priority):
- Collect KMS audit log (who/when disabled or destroyed key versions) for key ring relevant to HarborWell.
- Determine whether old key versions were scheduled for destruction or disabled by accident.
- If key material is destroyed, we need legal + compliance convo (possible permanent loss).
- Provide HarborWell with temporary compensating controls and timeline.

sara_support: customer asks: can you restore access so they can produce an auditor bundle for their HIPAA audit next week? They are escalating to their compliance team.

carl_engineer: If the key version was rotated but not destroyed, we can re-enable decrypt rights for the service account that runs exporters and re-run rekey job. If destroyed, we need to escalate to leadership + legal.

mike_sre: I pulled the KMS listing: cryptoKeyVersions for projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/baa-keys/cryptoKeys/harborwell-audit show v1 (STATE: DESTROY_SCHEDULED, destroy_time 2025-11-02), v2 (ENABLED). The rekey job attempted to use v1 but it was scheduled for destruction during the window. That explains kms:KeyNotAllowed/KeyNotFound.

olivia_security: important: if v1 is scheduled for destruction but not yet destroyed we may be able to restore via cloud provider restore API until destroy_time passes. Need immediate action.

raj_oncall: I'm opening an escalation with cloud KMS support now. Also ping legal.

deploy-bot: deploy completed audit-exporter v2.4.2 to compliance-importers at 2025-11-03T02:10:23Z :thumbsup:

mike_sre: action items assigned:
- raj_oncall: open cloud KMS emergency restore request and include destroy_time + key path (done).
- olivia_security: prepare an incident summary and compliance impact statement we can share with HarborWell (in DM)
- carl_engineer: if restore is allowed, run re-encrypt/rekey job for org-9876 and confirm object accessibility. If not allowed, prepare list of affected time ranges and legal escalation notes.
- sara_support: keep HarborWell updated with blunt timeline and ask for any alternate backup of logs on their side.

sara_support: HarborWell: thanks for patience — we're escalating to cloud KMS and security. We'll update within 2 hours or sooner. :handshake:

harborwell_followup (posted to ticket by sara_support): "They mentioned they do not have a local copy of older exports. Their compliance deadline is 2025-11-12. Please treat as P1 HIPAA compliance."

olivia_security: also note for remediation we should add automated verification in the rekey job: after re-encrypting object, validate a sample decrypt with service account before marking success. Filing a follow-up RFC.

mike_sre: I'll attach logs and KMS listing to the support ticket. If cloud KMS supports restoring v1 before destroy_time we should have a path to recover and re-run exporter. If destroy already executed, initiate legal/compliance playbook.

sara_support: thanks everyone. I'll post updates from cloud support here.

[two hours later]

raj_oncall: cloud KMS responded: we can cancel destruction (restore) for v1 if we submit an emergency request; they provisionally accepted, restore ETA 45-90 min. We requested immediate restore and provided org-9876 justification.

mike_sre: great. once restored I'll kick the rekey job for only org-9876 in dry-run mode then full run. I'll signal here when dry-run shows decryptable objects.

olivia_security: prepping a short letter for HarborWell compliance describing timeline, root cause, and mitigation. Keep communications controlled.

sara_support: HarborWell updated: "Appreciate the rapid escalation. Please confirm when we can export for 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-15."

mike_sre: will update after dry-run completes. expected full resolution within 6 hours if restore succeeds.

sara_support: placing this thread into the ticket. closing Slack loop for public channel but will update thread with final status. :white_check_mark:
